roadmap: 10 ②a stable references to parts inside sub-assemblies (owner order 'Go to row 10')

issues.#2180: occurrence identity: a mate or drawing reference to a part inside a sub-assembly keeps pointing at that part when the sub-assembly changes

tier: full (reference semantics + public API: three audit rounds incl. mutation, actual run)
defectBefore: flattenAssembly renumbers a nested part's feature ids by position (Block B's n1.top folded as n3.top, n4.top after an earlier sibling gained a feature); Studio mates and drawing names stored those folded names, so an edit, hide or reorder of an earlier sibling silently broke or re-aimed them; the model's tablesFor did not fold sub-assemblies (model API could not see nested faces; Studio could)

change.mapping: engine/occurrences.ts: flatFaceOf / faceOriginOf built from flatten.ts flattenPlan (flattenAssembly calls it, so the mapping cannot drift)
change.references: MateRef.part may be an occurrence path 'sub1/p2' with the face in p2's own naming; the solver moves the first segment; addMate converts a host-id + folded nested name to the path form; an unresolvable path is refused (NO_PART, MATE_FACE_UNKNOWN); a saved unresolvable or host-form nested end is a solve problem asking to pick the face again, and an edit of such a mate is refused — never re-aimed
change.consumers: hostOf for placements in robot joints/loop, team rebuild, declaredContact, chat delete_part/place_part, placePart grounding; tablesFor folds (a sub-assembly's own table lists only its own faces)
change.drawings: nested faces named sub1/p2/n1.top (top-level and base names unchanged)
change.agent/facade: get_assembly parts_inside with paths, faces_of a path; facade mate ends: whole name first, then path, id beats name, ambiguity refused
change.studio: a pick on a sub-assembly face is stored in path form; Mates panel shows 'Sub › Block B · Top face'
change.ids: '/' in an instance id refused on read

audits.round1: CHANGES_REQUIRED: 2 high (the change itself let model/chat/facade store fragile folded-name references; path mates ignored by robot joints, loops, contact, Mates panel), 2 medium (delete/ground of a sub-assembly ignored path mates; facade name parsing), 1 low ('/' ids) — all fixed with tests
audits.round2: CHANGES_REQUIRED: 1 high (an edit of a stored host-form mate re-aimed it, flagged by the implementer) — fixed; plain assemblies' robot/URDF/MJCF/SDF/loop outputs byte-identical to HEAD on 8 robot samples; 6 mutants killed
